 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan

Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned SPP for the State.

This is an appeal under Section 14(a)(2) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (hereinafter in short referred to as the 'SC/ST Act), against the refusal of prayer of anticipatory bail vide order dated 06.07.2021 passed by learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 1st Bhojpur at Ara in SC/ST case no. 49/2021 in connection with Ara P.S. Case No.240/2021 registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3(1)(r)(s)(w)/3(2)(v)(s)/3(I)(w)(2)/3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.3330 of 2021(5) dt.21-06-2023 Atrocities) Act.
